top_signals.title: The $3 trillion oil market has just gotten more accessible than ever: No longer a 'rich man's game'
top_signals.summary: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors as smaller futures contracts, ETFs and online brokerages lower longtime barriers to the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
